title: IntakeSchema
description: Schema for Person 2 Voice Intake & NLP standardized patient encounter data

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for the intake interaction

patient_id.description: Optional patient identifier if known or provided

language.description: Language code selected by the patient (en: English, ta: Tamil)

chief_complaint.description: Canonical normalized chief complaint in English

duration.description: Normalized symptom onset duration (e.g. '2 hours', '1 day') or verbatim text if non-standard

medications.description: List of normalized medication names or ['none']

follow_up_answers.description: Map of adaptive clinical follow-up question keys to boolean responses

raw_transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of patient responses in their native spoken language

raw_transcripts.description: Per-question verbatim transcripts in patient's native language
